description: Finds countersigned receipts in the public log by receipt ID, deliverable hash (file SHA-256) or seller key. Shows a seller's published proof of delivery history. The log only holds receipts that a seller or buyer chose to publish, and a key is not a verified identity.

receipt_id.description: Receipt id (urn:uuid:...) or log sequence number.

name: lookup_delivery_receipt
title: Look up a countersigned receipt
